colorectal.label: Bevacizumab component: Day 1 every 14 days
colorectal.prescription_note: No routine antiemetic prophylaxis for the bevacizumab component. The prescribed fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy requires its own antiemetic and supportive-care plan; minimal risk here does not classify the whole combination.
additional_support: Premedication is not usually required unless there has been previous hypersensitivity; the treating team specifies any individual plan.
Review blood pressure, urine protein, bleeding, thrombosis, wounds and planned procedures before dosing.
Provide a prescribed diarrhoea plan appropriate to the chemotherapy partner; bevacizumab does not define a universal loperamide schedule.
Urgent assessment for significant bleeding, severe abdominal pain, chest pain, sudden breathlessness, severe headache, confusion, seizure or visual disturbance.
Use the separate chemotherapy schedule and support prescription. No lung six-cycle limit or ovarian course cap applies to this colorectal context.

guidance.label: NCCP regimen supportive care; NCCP antiemetic classification V6
